name: Cross-listed price convergence
hypothesis: Enter prefunded hedged legs only after currency, ratio, fees, and simultaneous tradability are reconciled.
spec: Setup: The same economic security can temporarily differ across accessible venues. Entry: Enter prefunded hedged legs only after currency, ratio, fees, and simultaneous tradability are reconciled. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on net spread convergence or the predefined leg-risk stop. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time constituent breadth or auction imbalance data (not free)
